My amendment would have also cut 50% of NSF funding, ended refugee welfare cash handouts, and reduced the Department of Education by 16%, returning authority to the states.
Instead, 27 Republicans sided with Democrats to keep the spending flowing. It's a shame.

These are some of the crazy spending items your hard-earned dollars are funding:
❌￼$4.8M for Ukrainian social media influencers
❌￼$2M for transgender surgeries in Guatemala
￼❌$25K for a transgender opera in Colombia
❌￼$20M for a new Sesame Street show in Iraq
❌￼$6M to promote tourism in Egypt
￼❌$70K for a DEI music event in Ireland

My amendment would have slashed 90% of foreign aid.

Last week, I offered an amendment to fully fund ICE & Border Patrol, and be paid for by cutting wasteful foreign aid, refugee welfare, bloated NSF grants, and a bloated Department of Education.

27 Senate Republicans voted with the Democrats to kill it. 🧵￼

As Chairman of HSGAC and a member of the National Capital Planning Commission, I’ve reviewed the White House ballroom proposal and support moving it forward. Tomorrow, I’ll bring my bill to the floor that allows it to proceed without new taxpayer costs and make it easier for Congress to review major White House projects going forward.

Back in 2016 at the @NRA Annual Meeting, I made clear what I still believe today: you cannot defend the Second Amendment without defending the entire Bill of Rights. The right to bear arms stands alongside free speech, religious liberty, and freedom from unreasonable search. Weaken one, you weaken them all.

Video

The Fourth Amendment isn't optional. If the government wants to read your messages, search your data, or spy on you, they need a warrant. Period.

My Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act ends warrantless surveillance of Americans.

Interest on our debt hit $1.22 trillion this year. More than we spend on defense. My Six Penny Plan fixes this. Congress just has to have the courage to cut six cents on the dollar.

foxnews.com/opinion/sen-rand…
On Friday I was in Taylorsville to meet with local leaders in Spencer County with @MassieforKY and talk about their most pressing issues.

I introduced the Six Penny Plan because the answer to our debt crisis isn't complicated. Cut six cents off every dollar. Balance the budget in five years. Protect your children's future. The only thing standing in the way is Washington's refusal to live within its means.
I've been the lone vote against runaway spending for years. It shouldn't be this hard to convince Washington to balance a checkbook. Every American does it. Washington should, too.
Thank God the President and all of the attendees tonight are safe.

Only American citizens should vote in American elections. That's not controversial. That's common sense.

The SAVE Act would have required proof of citizenship to register and vote. Four Republicans joined Democrats to kill it. Shameful.

foxnews.com/politics/republi…
The Founders knew exactly what they were doing. They lived under a government that searched without cause and seized without reason. They made sure we never would again. Defend the Fourth Amendment.
Your private messages are none of the government's business. Not without a warrant. I've been fighting warrantless surveillance since day one, and I'm not stopping now.

I didn't come to Washington to grow government. I came to shrink it. I’m proud to have earned the #1 spot on the Limited Government Index.


Institute for Legislative Analysis (@leganalysis)

The FBI shouldn't be able to read your private messages without a warrant. Full stop. The Fourth Amendment doesn't have a national security exception.

I've been fighting warrantless surveillance for years, and I won't stop now.

theblaze.com/columns/opinion…
Started the day off in Lexington this morning at an event hosted by UK’s Patterson School of Diplomacy where I spoke to students and faculty and answered their questions on foreign policy.
Great to be in my home county for the Warren County GOP Lincoln Day dinner last night! Always a good time seeing so many friends.

Washington doesn't have a revenue problem. It has a spending problem.

My Six Penny Plan is simple: cut six cents out of every dollar the federal government plans to spend. Do that for five years, and we balance the budget.
Safety and liberty are not a choice. My Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act proves you can have both, without giving unelected agencies a blank check to spy on Americans.
